Done. `backoff` now doubles each attempt and never waits longer than 30 s.

## What changed

- `backoff(attempt)` returns `100ms << attempt`, capped at **30 000 ms**
- `give_up` compares against `MAX_ATTEMPTS` instead of a literal `3`

```rust
pub fn backoff(attempt: u32) -> u64 {
    (100u64 << attempt.min(9)).min(30_000)
}
```

| attempt | wait |
|---|---|
| 1 | 200 ms |
| 5 | 3.2 s |
| 9+ | 30 s |

The tests did not run here, so `MAX_ATTEMPTS` still needs defining. See [the retry notes](https://example.com/retry).
